summary: On August 17, 2026 JLS, a South Korean language academy operator, detected abnormal mass external access to its member database and confirmed a breach the next day. Exposed data included names, dates of birth, phone numbers, email and home addresses, school information, grades, user IDs and encrypted passwords. JLS reported to authorities and police on August 21; the access route and scale were still under investigation.
